sideA.summary: November is when Utopia sends out new Hollow Men and is distracted for two days. Recon has to happen this month or the opening is gone. They do not know what the city or PEARL holds, and they need to be ready for either.
sideA.text: This is the month Utopia releases new Hollow Men and is distracted for two days. Recon has to happen this month or the chance is lost. They do not know what they will find in the city or at PEARL, and they need to be prepared.

sideB.summary: Archive, June 18, Year 10. After ten years at sea and five toward a cure, some people in the havens still resent the quarantine. Minds have recovered from COdA, but faded skin is permanent, including in children. Isolation in the havens became humanity's last hope.
sideB.text:
JUNE 18, YEAR 10
Ten years at sea and five toward a cure. Some in the havens still resent being quarantined. Minds have recovered from the long-term effects of COdA, but the faded skin is permanent, and children are born faded. The havens' isolation when the plague struck became humanity's last hope.
sideB.footer: Keep papers like this in the reserve.
